note:
METHOD: one background triage script (MusicBrainz and Deezer for 68 composers, then Apple's composerTerm song search for the composers both missed); MusicBrainz and Apple were skipped where Deezer showed a chamber-titled hit, so a supplementary MusicBrainz/Apple run covered 18 composers whose Deezer 'hit' was a namesake, and a last Apple pass covered Becker, Bertouch, Aubert, Aufschnaiter and Buffardin. No lookup failed. About 70 tool calls, 1 WebSearch. LESSON: Apple's composerTerm results rarely carry the composer in the track or album title, so a surname filter hides hits (Arnold, Böhm, Bertouch, Aufschnaiter, Campioni were found only by reading the results for chamber-titled tracks); the brief's triage should say so.
HITS (113 works): Boyce (12 trio sonatas; Chandos and Hyperion), Becker (14 pieces of the 1674 print, 2 sonatas of 1668), Avitrano Op. 1 (10), Aldrovandini Op. 5 (10), Aufschnaiter Op. 4 (8), Bernardi Op. 2 (10, added, not on IMSLP), Buchner Op. 4 (10), Carolo (9), Buonamente (6), Bertouch (5), Campioni (2, The Vivaldi Project), Chéron Op. 2 (4 trios), Bononcini (2), Albrici (2), Heinrich and Johann Michael Bach (one each, Clematis/Ricercar 2026), Buffardin, Barbella, Böhm (viola d'amore trio), Albicastro Op. 3 No. 9 (low), Abel's Sonata sopra Cuccu (added).
SCOPE CALLS: Carolo is known by one name only; the checker needs 'Surname, Given', so the works carry 'Carolo' (rename or drop). Boyce's single pages are filed as 2 violins and cello by the census; the 1747 print says bass for violoncello or harpsichord, so the entries are 2 violins and continuo. Aldrovandini Op. 5: IMSLP dates the print 1710, the recording's title says Bologna 1706; I used 1706. Avitrano's sonatas are 'a 4' on the recording (violone folded into continuo). Buchner: the Parnassi Musici disc credits the Bavarian Chamber Orchestra, so the four five-part sonatas (Nos. 19, 21-23) are skipped as string-orchestra question; the ten kept use small forces. Buonamente's Book 6 pieces are matched to Monica Huggett's track titles only, Sonata quinta 'Poi che noi rimena' is low (her disc says Book 6, IMSLP Book 4). Bertouch No. 7 rests on a live album (low). Bernardi's Op. 2 and Abel's Cuccu are added from discs; Cuccu's scoring (violin, viola da gamba, continuo) is from Stretta Music's edition. Böhm's trio is the Concerto in G (viola d'amore, oboe d'amore, bassoon); the oboe d'amore is entered as oboe.
STRING-ORCHESTRA QUESTION: Albicastro Op. 7 (12 concerti a quattro; Collegium Marianum, Pan Classics, complete), Bononcini Op. 3 No. 8 and No. 10 (sinfonias with trumpet: I Musici, ASMF/Marriner, La Follia), Beer's Concerto a 4 for horn and posthorn (Kammerorchester C. P. E. Bach, Haenchen), Aubert's Concert de simphonies Suite No. 5 (Collegium Musicum 90). No one-to-a-part recording found for any.
UNMATCHED OR WEAK: Becker's D minor sonata and Sonata à 5 of 1668 (several recordings, no numbers); Deuter's Partiturbuch Ludwig disc (Accent 2012) records unnumbered 'Canzona a 4' and 'Ciaccona a 3' that may be Anonymous Nos. 71 and 63; Arnold's Op. 3 (capriccios, canzon, aria: Ars Antiqua Austria, Vita & Anima, Capella Ornamentata) cannot be matched to the pages; Camerloher Op. 2 No. 2 (Neue Freisinger Hofmusik, 2015, 'Kammerensemble'); Heinrich Bach's Sonata in F major (Clematis) and Bertouch's Suite for two violins (Trondheim Barokk) have no page here. OUT-OF-SCOPE PAGES WORTH A LOOK: Aufschnaiter 'Concors Discordia, Op.2' (serenades à 4 and à 5, L'Orfeo Barockorchester, CPO; Ars Antiqua Austria) and Bononcini '12 Sinfonie, Op.3'.
WEAK 'none found' (namesakes or odd names): Bart, Beck, Bertram, Bianchi, Carusi, Anderssen, Bornong-Bros, Bononcini G. M., Cattaneo, Antonii. Anonymous: 24 distinctive titles searched on Deezer and 5 on Apple, nothing matched; pages known only by shelfmark cannot be searched. Levels: Corellian trio-sonata writing is graded 2-3 (benchmark Corelli Op. 1 No. 1 = 2); most entries are 3; years and minutes come from the discs and IMSLP. HAND EDIT (orchestrator, 2026-10-17): the single-name composer 'Carolo, (given name unknown)' is written 'Carolo' (owner's single-name rule).
